description: DISA India Limited manufactures and sells foundry machinery and machinery parts in India and internationally. The company offers moulding machines; sand mixers with the combination of sand plant equipment; and surface preparation machines and environmental control systems. It also provides vertical spot feeding, DISA Grind, automation solutions, including automatic core feeder, filter setter, and pattern changer; secondhand machines; and spare parts and services. In addition, the company offers Monitizer products, such as DETECT, used to keep machines running with early alerts, detailed diagnostics, and engineering insights that prevent downtime; CIM to Automate, sync, and control machine-to-machine processes; TAG that enables traceability and quality control into every single casting; MAC, which is used to capture high-precision mould data for pouring, measuring mismatch, gaps, steps, and parallelism; DISCOVER, for viewing production data and KPIs in real time; and PRESCRIBE. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India. DISA India Limited is a subsidiary of DISA Holding AG.
